scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install
scripts.lint: npm --prefix backend run lint:check && npm --prefix frontend run lint
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix backend run typecheck && npm --prefix frontend run typecheck
scripts.format:check: npm --prefix backend run format:check && npm --prefix frontend run format:check
scripts.test: npm --prefix backend test && npm --prefix backend run test:e2e
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run format:check
